career_paths.title: Android Developer
career_paths.description: Master modern Android development with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and Clean Architecture.

knowledge_nuggets.title: Kotlin Coroutines
knowledge_nuggets.content: Coroutines are light-weight threads that allow you to write asynchronous code sequentially. They simplify background tasks and prevent blocking the UI thread.

knowledge_nuggets.title: Jetpack Compose Basics
knowledge_nuggets.content: Compose is Android's modern toolkit for building native UI. It simplifies and accelerates UI development with less code, powerful tools, and intuitive Kotlin APIs.

career_paths.title: UI/UX Designer
career_paths.description: Learn to design beautiful, user-centered mobile and web applications.

knowledge_nuggets.title: Typography in Design
knowledge_nuggets.content: Typography is more than just picking a font. It's about readability, hierarchy, and creating a visual tone for your application.
